claims.claim: SRD 5.1 Appendix PH-C "The Planes of Existence" (pp. 363-365) is the only sustained place-describing prose in the document, and measures 1,530 words across 9 paragraphs and 72 sentences.
claims.source: Finder measurement over SRD 5.1 (Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0, 403 pp.), pdftotext extraction
claims.quote: Appendix PH-C: The Planes of Existence

claims.claim: Wizards of the Coast states that it removed the appendices "Fantasy-Historical Pantheons" and "The Planes of Existence" from SRD 5.2 because they are not rules-bearing.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Beyond, "System Reference Document" page, last updated March 02, 2026
claims.quote: as those are not rules-bearing to play fifth edition
claims.page: SRD page, SRD 5.2 FAQ, Appendix row
claims.routeHint: curl with a browser user agent; dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document redirects to www.dndbeyond.com/srd

claims.claim: Wizards of the Coast states that SRD 5.2 is meant to give creators a foundation for original material rather than to reproduce the D&D setting.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Beyond, "System Reference Document" page, last updated March 02, 2026
claims.quote: not to replicate every element of the D&D brand or setting
claims.routeHint: curl with a browser user agent; dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document redirects to www.dndbeyond.com/srd

claims.claim: Wizards of the Coast states that it removed the "Between Adventures" section from SRD 5.2 because it is not in the 2024 core rules.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Beyond, "System Reference Document" page, last updated March 02, 2026
claims.quote: Removed: “Between Adventures” section as that is not featured
claims.routeHint: curl with a browser user agent; dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document redirects to www.dndbeyond.com/srd
